headline: Expo SDK 57: What's New and How to Upgrade (React Native 0.86)
description: Expo SDK 57 brings React Native 0.86 with no breaking changes. What is new, the two behaviour changes to watch, known issues and a safe upgrade checklist.

itemListElement.name: Expo SDK 57: What's New and How to Upgrade (React Native 0.86)

mainEntity.name: What version of React Native does Expo SDK 57 use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expo SDK 57 uses React Native 0.86 with React 19.2. SDK 56 used React Native 0.85 with the same React version.

mainEntity.name: Does Expo SDK 57 have breaking changes?

acceptedAnswer.text: React Native 0.86 is intended to have no breaking changes from 0.85. Two behaviour changes need attention: expo prebuild now regenerates native folders by default, and apps built with the iOS 27 SDK need the scene-based lifecycle.

mainEntity.name: How do I upgrade to Expo SDK 57?

acceptedAnswer.text: Run npx expo install expo@^57.0.0 --fix, then npx expo-doctor, rebuild your development client and test on real devices.

mainEntity.name: Are there known bugs in Expo SDK 57?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two early ones: a memory regression with Hermes V1 in apps using reanimated or worklets, fixed in expo 57.0.9, and slower development start-up, fixed in expo 57.0.17. Use the latest patch.

mainEntity.name: Will expo prebuild delete my native changes?

acceptedAnswer.text: In SDK 57 it clears and regenerates the android and ios directories by default. Pass --no-clean to keep existing folders, or move manual edits into config plugins.
